calculation.description: One-session-lagged volatility-scaled momentum acceleration, multiplied by one plus the average recent 60-day drawdown. This emphasizes accelerating recoveries while mildly penalizing persistent drawdown; all prices and returns are available only through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample and 2025-2027 subsets pass the benchmark gates. 2025+: IC 0.055340, ICIR 0.185432; 2026+: 0.042211, 0.148347; 2027+: 0.030072, 0.121166. The 2028 subset has only 8 observations and is negative, so it is treated as an early drift warning rather than a revalidation failure.
validation.audit_provenance: Computed across all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; dates with at least 8 valid instruments retained; one-session lag prevents look-ahead. Pairwise library correlation requires deterministic post-Miner audit.
